QuestInfo.name: Larelle's Diary
QuestInfo.0: Could #p2430000# in #m323000000# be the Goddess Teardrop? Alpha and Beta headed to #b#MDmap323090100##k to get answers from #b#p2430003##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2430003# told them that #p2430000# had summoned a monster that rampaged through town... and it wasn't the first time. Alpha and Beta set off for #b#m323090130##k to see the creature for themselves.
QuestInfo.2: The monster in #p2430000#'s home had the power of time. The evidence that #p2430000# was one of the Goddess Teardrops was piling up, but why wasn't he able to control his powers? Alpha and Beta read his diary in the hopes of finding out, but only found the rantings of a terribly depressed boy.

0.0: I don't know why you two are looking for Larelle, but he's a good person just trying to get by. He's done nothing wrong. If you don't believe me, go see where he lives. His house is #bon the western hill#k. I'm sure he's not there right now...
0.1: Maybe you could be nice and clear out the rest of the #bmonsters in his house#k while you're there. I'm sure the poor kid is scared out of his wits.

yes.0: If you really want to know more about Larelle, go see his house. Maybe you'll find something inside that will help you get to know him.
